content: Get your Splattershots ready. Nintendo just released a new demo for Splatoon Raiders, the single-player-focused Splatoon spin-off that came out earlier this year. “A demo version of Splatoon Raiders is now available on Nintendo Switch 2!” reads a post from Splatoon’s X account. “Get a taste of the Spirhalite Islands with 3 different stages, and team up with Deep Cut to take 3 preselected loadouts for a test splat.”
